title: Data Mapper
text: Map integer symbols from one coding scheme to another, 1 input, 1 output, {Mapping mode} sets Mapping mode Binary to; {Symbol set size (M)} and {Mapping vector} sets the maps input elements to the output elements. Values come from the instance.
